cases.description: IDN lines with strict scheme handling
One trailing root dot, ASCII or a UTS #46 full stop (U+3002, U+FF0E, U+FF61), is dropped before the domain row, as ICU does

UTS #46 conversion by Core's x/net/idna profile (owner sign-off 2026-11-12 (#3906): Core uses golang.org/x/net/idna, the pfb-dns profile): fullwidth, NFD (Latin, Greek, Cyrillic), ligature U+FB01, circled U+2460, U+01C6, sharp s, final sigma, U+2024, U+2026, U+0E33, U+115F, U+0345 and the bidi rule. Lines without an old_expect agree with ICU's idn_to_ascii(); sharp s and final sigma are the non-transitional answers; their old_expect is the appliance's transitional ICU (ss.com, xn--4xa.com), replayed live
NUL, control, DEL, high bytes and invalid UTF-8 in plain lines; U+180E carries an old_expect, owner sign-off 2026-11-12 (#3906): Core uses golang.org/x/net/idna, the pfb-dns profile

Lines made only of Unicode whitespace are blank; whitespace does not hide ! // and [ markers
